name: @hamzaabili/opencode-sandbox
description: OpenCode plugin (V1+V2): agent shell commands run in a native OS sandbox by default — bubblewrap on Linux, Seatbelt on macOS — with a read-only system, a writable project, cleared environment and network denied by default. Trusted policy outside the workspace, protected OpenCode/Git config, a V2 in-process guard for file tools and webfetch. V2 also covers the terminal shell; V1 covers the agent bash tool. Fail-closed in enforce mode, zero runtime dependencies.
author: Hamza-Abili

scripts.ci: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.compat: bun run ci && bun run smoke
